name: Kado (Ikebana) VR
summary:
Kado (Ikebana) is a traditional Japanese art form that treats flowers as an art form.
Kado is a combination of floral arranging techniques and aesthetics,
The goal is to present flowers in a beautiful and harmonious arrangement.

Kado(Ikebana) VR allows you to experience flower arrangement while having fun using hand tracking.
